description: Screen a household for hospital financial assistance (charity care): returns income as a percent of the federal poverty guidelines, the typical range hospital policies cover, what federal rules (IRS 501(r)) do and do not guarantee, and next steps. Use when a user asks whether they might qualify for help paying a hospital bill. It is a screening estimate, not an eligibility decision: each hospital sets its own limits. Needs household size and annual household income; do not ask for names, account numbers or bill details.

annual_household_income.description: Total annual household income before taxes, in dollars

household_size.description: Number of people in the household, including the patient

state.description: 2-letter US state code; only Alaska and Hawaii change the poverty guideline

name: check_financial_assistance
